## Personality

Hannah's economical nature makes her unwilling to allow room space to go to waste. Additionally, she desires to be good without having to exert any effort to achieve it.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P7](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0007), [v3 ch.Farewell P21](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0021)_
